title: capabilities.files
description: The `files` provider's block of a freedom-manifest/2 `capabilities` object. See providers/files.md §6.

own.description: files:own — read, write, mark and delete the dapp's own files, shared or private (consent tier). No scope.

read.description: files:read — read the shared files of every author, by type-named queries (consent tier). No scope: providers/files.md §3, §4.
